description: This file defines a UsersController class for handling user-related HTTP endpoints in an ASP.NET Core application. It provides actions for creating users and login, leveraging MediatR for command handling.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller for user-related API endpoints, handles user creation and login actions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new user, delegating the command to MediatR.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST for user login, delegating the login command to MediatR.
